explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 23 sits near -0.96 and rises (less negative) mainly at GO when the ideal observer believes S2 is good: graded in tanh(belief_lo/2) with negative weight, strongest at GO (about 3x the D1/D2 slope) and growing later in the episode (GO belief x ep_dec term). Also higher at GO after the previous choice was a2, especially when that a2 went unrewarded (+0.045), and at D1 after a rewarded a2; a large +0.27 jump at D1 of the episode first trial. Observed-only, 7 terms: dev R^2 beyond timing 0.72, test 0.71 (all-observed ceiling 0.78, all 0.83). The earlier policy-based explanation (policy decile alone 0.72) loses essentially nothing when replaced by belief + last trial: the unit tracks the a2/S2 preference the agent infers from history. This trial reward and value do not matter (0.00 / 0.01).

(phase == D1) * (last_is("a2 S1 r") + last_is("a2 S2 r"))

issues: The claim 'higher at D1 after a rewarded a2' is imprecise. Fitting the two rewarded-a2 cases separately at D1 gives a2 S1 r (rare rewarded) +0.036 and a2 S2 r (common rewarded) +0.003. The effect is specific to rare-rewarded a2, which the model-based rule reads as a switch toward a1 / evidence that S1 is good. After the original terms, misses still under-predicts it: D1 after a2 S1 r +0.026, D2 after a2 S1 r +0.021.
That a2 S1 r effect also shows up at D2, not just D1. Using (phase != GO)*last_is('a2 S1 r') in place of the pooled D1 term raises test R^2 from 0.711 to 0.723.

The 'previous choice was a2' main effect at GO is tiny in the full fit (weight +0.005 on a +/-1 code, so about 0.01 between a1 and a2). The GO effect sits almost entirely in the unrewarded-a2 term, where a2 S1 u and a2 S2 u fit to about equal weights (+0.046, +0.047).

The remaining claims hold up. Belief at GO carries most of the fit: the 4 base terms alone score 0.608 test. Dropping the GO belief x ep_dec term lowers test R^2 from 0.711 to 0.701, so the late-episode growth is real but small. GO slope / D1-D2 slope is about 2.6x early in the episode and grows later. The D1 first-trial jump (+0.26 to +0.27) is real. Misses by phase are near zero on average (D1 -0.000, GO -0.003, D2 +0.004). The largest leftover pattern is GO after a1 S2 r, over-predicted by -0.019. No large systematic error class remains.
